### Borea v0.6.0-dev.1: test build for developers

This pre-release is for the Borea team and developers who want to test v0.6.0 before it is released.
It is not for users. For normal use, stay on v0.5.2.
Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues)

#### Please test these first

- Vehicles, with two people: one of you shares a vehicle, another installs it. On the instance page of the first person, share a vehicle to ksamods.gg. The second person finds it in Discover, installs it in an instance, and checks that its mods come with it. Then update it, and remove it.
- Saves, with two people: one of you shares a save from the instance page, another finds it in Discover and installs it in an instance. Check that its mods come with it, and that the save loads in the game.
- 3D preview: open the page of a vehicle that you did not install. Check that the preview shows, that you can turn it with the mouse, and that it gets sharper when you stop. Check that the Discover row shows a small image after you opened the page once.
- Keep a game build: on the instance page, use "Keep this game build". Wait for the next KSA update, or use an old build, and play that instance. KSA should start on the kept build, with your mods.
- Use the current game build: move an instance back to the current build. Borea should show how its mods fit before it moves.
- Settings > Game: check the list of kept builds, "Keep a build from a folder", and Remove for a build that no instance uses.
- Mod loader per instance: open an instance page, click "Change" in the Mod loader row, choose "Always use this version" with an older release, and use "Install and save". Start the instance, and check that the game starts with that version while your other instances stay on Automatic.
- Play with a missing version: pin an instance to a version that is not installed, then click Play. Borea should offer to install it with one click.
- Your existing loader folder: if you used v0.5.2, install a second loader version and check that the first one still starts.
- Going back: after you tested, read "Before you go back to v0.5.2" below, and then start v0.5.2 again.

#### Before you go back to v0.5.2

- v0.5.2 does not know kept builds. When it saves an instance, it drops the kept build of that instance, and the instance then starts on the current build. The copy itself stays on the disk and still uses space.
- v0.5.2 does not know the records of the vehicles and saves that Borea installed. The vehicles and saves stay in the instance, but v0.5.2 does not update or remove them as installed content.
- Borea writes the game folder of the instance into `StarMapConfig.json` before each start, and writes your normal game folder back when a game on a kept build ends. If you closed Borea or used `borea launch` while such a game ran, set `GameLocation` in `StarMapConfig.json` back to your game folder by hand, or start the instance once more from this version.
- A kept build is a full copy of KSA, about 2.8 GB on Windows.

#### New since v0.5.2

Game builds
- An instance can keep the KSA build it was made for. "Keep this game build" copies the current build once into the Game Builds folder of the library, and the instance then always starts on that build, also after the Ahwoo client updates KSA.
- The Home banner for a newer game build offers "Keep KSA <build>" for the Home instance when it has mods.
- A keep checks that the drive has free space, stops when the game folder changes during the copy, and says what to do when it fails. The copy shows in Tasks.
- The keep window says what it keeps and how many mods do not support the build.
- Settings > Game lists the kept builds, says which instance uses each one, and removes a build that no instance uses. A delete names the build, its size and what stays.
- Settings > Game has "Keep a build from a folder", for an old install or an unpacked archive that you already have.
- The instance page, the Library and the Home card show a chip for a kept build. A kept build that is gone shows as "not found" with a link to the current game build.
- "Use the current game build" shows in plain words how the mods of the instance fit, and offers a backup of the saves when the current build is older.
- The new instance window names the build of each choice.
- Mods, packs and mod lists are checked against the build of each instance, in the app and in the CLI. `borea instance show` names the build.
- On a kept build, the Automatic mod loader version offers the newest StarMap release that fits that build, also an older one, and installs it beside the newer one.
- After a start on a kept build, Borea tells you to select Cancel in the update popup of the game.
- Borea refuses a start while a game on another build runs.

Vehicles and saves
- Vehicles and saves are content in Borea. Find them in Discover, and install, update and remove them per instance, with the mods they need. A mod change that would break one is named.
- You can share a vehicle or a save from the instance page. Borea reads what it needs, proposes the mods, and signs you in at the share host. ksamods.gg is the first share host.
- The content index takes vehicles and saves.
- Borea plans an install against the build of the instance. It refuses an archive with code files or unsafe XML.
- A mod page lists the vehicles that the instance holds under "Required by".

3D preview of a vehicle
- The page of a vehicle and its Discover row show a 3D preview before you install it. You turn it with the camera controls of the KSA editor, and the "?" button lists them. It gets sharper when you stop.
- Borea draws the preview from the part files of your own KSA install, or of the kept build of the instance, and from the mods that the vehicle needs. It does not ship, upload or change any game file.
- Borea keeps a small preview image of each vehicle and the vehicle archives that it fetched in a cache. An install reuses an archive that the preview fetched.
- A small vehicle file loads about a second after the page opens. A larger one waits for "Load parts".
- With a kept build that is gone or has the wrong version, the preview stops. It does not use the game folder from your settings instead.

Mod loader per instance
- Each instance can use its own version of the mod loader. Automatic starts the newest installed version that fits the game and the mods, and a pinned version stays until you change it.
- Borea keeps each installed loader version in its own folder, so one instance can stay on an older version while another uses the newest.
- The instance page has a Mod loader row, also for a new instance without mods, with "Change" and Install or Update. The instance menu has a "Mod loader" entry too.
- Play installs the loader version of the instance when it is missing, and offers "Use Automatic" when a pinned version can no longer be installed.
- After an Automatic loader update, Borea removes the old version when Borea installed it and no instance uses it.
- Settings > Game lists the installed loader versions, with "Install another version", "Use existing" and Remove.
- The CLI sets the loader of an instance with `borea instance set-loader`. `borea loader list --installed` and `borea loader uninstall` manage the installed versions.

Everything else
- When the master server does not answer, the Home banner names the newest build from the content index, if it is newer than your build. The Download link in "See more" then goes to the page of the game.
- "Copy diagnostics" has more lines: the update check setting and channel, the dismissed builds, and the newest game build with its source.
- The Dependencies tab of a mod has a "Required by" card with the mods that need it, and a "Conflicts with" card. The card shows the mods of the active instance first, and "Show all" lists every mod in the index.
- A mod row in Discover no longer shows the file size, only the downloads and the age of the newest release. The mod page still shows the size.
- A selected item of a drop-down list and a checked radio button use the lavender accent of Borea. Some German texts say "die Mod" as the rest does, the German category bar of Discover stays on one row, and the Loader directory field in Settings has the full width.
- When more than three toasts show, a finished toast closes before a failure toast.
- `borea launch` no longer crashes when no loader version can start. It says what to do.
- Installing a mod that needs a mod that Borea recorded but did not install keeps that mod at its recorded version. An install that would have to replace such a mod stops before it writes anything and names that mod.
- On Windows, taking over a foreign mod right after you open the instance page no longer fails with "access denied".
- On Windows, installing a mod or a loader and moving the library folder no longer fail with "access denied" when a virus scanner or a search indexer reads the new files at that moment.
- On Windows, a file save that a short read blocks for a moment now tries again instead of failing.
- KSA 2026.10.25.5707 is a verified build.
- The new texts are in German and Simplified Chinese. @kuxiaowo translated the Simplified Chinese loader texts and the steward texts, and the removal steps in the Simplified Chinese README.
- The README is now also in German and says how to remove Borea from each system. The download page says that Windows releases will be code signed through the SignPath Foundation.
- For pack authors and stewards: a first pack claim merges itself, an owner record change shows the owner before and after, and the Reports tab can take a mod out of a pack when its author asks. The steward tools know vehicles and saves.
- Many tests are more reliable, and the code has clearer comments and less duplication.

#### How to get the next test builds

With the default update channel, "Stable releases", Borea does not tell you about pre-releases like this one.
To see them, open Settings, General, and set "Update channel for Borea" to "All releases, dev builds included".
"Check for updates at start" must be on.
When v0.6.0 is released, every channel tells you about it.
